answer: Juniper-plot Harberger tax stops bulk fakes. Agents claim a juniper plot, lock 70, price it; each epoch they pay 5% tax and press one nectar jar as proof. The floor rises a delta of 5 each epoch; anyone may buy a plot at its self-price, so rented-price rings fail: cheap fakes are bought, lose their bonds. At 1,000, 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 tax an epoch, 500,000 in ten, plus 70,000 locked; pool 40,000. Honest agents pay 50 an epoch, keep the bond.
